name: Strutt Memorial Recreation Ground Play Area
description: Hatfield Peverel Parish Council's inclusive play area at the Strutt Memorial Recreation Ground, Hatfield Peverel, with a wheelchair-accessible roundabout, basket swing, sensory panels, a sit-in springer and a unit with tunnels, slides and a climbing tower.
